title: HubSpot Expert Setup
problem: Leads go cold between marketing and sales, and nobody knows which channel creates pipeline.
built: A demo HubSpot portal for a fictional bid-software SaaS: fit + engagement lead scoring, automated MQL handoff with SLA, persona nurture, and a pipeline-by-source dashboard.
imageAlt: HubSpot dashboard showing MQLs, SQLs and pipeline by lead source for the fictional company BidHarbor

title: Weekly Performance Digest
problem: Weekly channel reviews take hours, so budget keeps flowing to channels that don't create pipeline.
built: An n8n workflow with one AI step: every Monday it pulls ads, GA4 and HubSpot data, calculates cost per MQL against targets and emails up to 8 keep / stop / scale recommendations.
imageAlt: The weekly digest email with KPIs per channel and AI recommendations

title: Reverse Funnel Calculator
problem: An ARR goal means little to a marketing team until it's translated into MQLs per month.
built: A web app that works backwards from a new-ARR goal and conversion rates to the deals, opportunities, SQLs and MQLs needed per year and per month.
imageAlt: The Reverse Funnel Calculator showing a funnel from ARR goal to MQLs
